findings.description: SYS-SUP-037 requires a start-up reset-cause message after classification but gives no deadline. CON-SUP-111 does not supply one, so lateness cannot be assessed. OP-SYS-001 records the missing acceptance limit.
findings.requested_change: Obtain the product owner's deadline and any necessary message format, then make the requirement verifiable.

findings.description: Coverage of STK-SUP-011, UC-SUP-008, CON-SUP-111, start-up, recovery or reset, and non-functional limits is partial because the reset-cause start-up message has no deadline. OP-SYS-001 tracks the decision. This combines the carried set findings that describe the same gap.
findings.requested_change: Resolve OP-SYS-001 and incorporate the agreed acceptance limit in the requirements.

findings.description: CON-SUP-127 specifies verification margins of at least 200 µs on either side of a timing limit. SYS-SUP-002, SYS-SUP-003, SYS-SUP-005 and SYS-SUP-056 state the timing behavior but the set does not record those verification margins.
findings.requested_change: Record the specified timing-limit verification margins for downstream verification.
